name: Segawa Natsuki
source: [url=/c21481]Ryousuke's[/url] classmate who is part of the graduation album production committee. Energetic, friendly, serious and funny, Natsuki is almost considered the committee's mascot. It is known throughout the school, both by students and teachers. She captures every moment of the students' lives to photograph them, her motto is that a photo is a bridge between the past, the present and the future.
